grammar: adj. 古代的；古老的。可作定语或表语；ancient times 指古代。
collocations: ancient history; an ancient city; ancient times
commonMistake: ancient 修饰名词时不变形；不要与 modern（现代的）混淆。

example.english: We visited an ancient town during the holiday.
example.chinese: 假期里我们参观了一座古镇。

application.prompt: The Great Wall has a long history. It is an ___ structure. A. ancient B. modern
application.solution: A。解析：有悠久历史的建筑可称为 ancient（古老的）。

grammar: n. 营地；度假营；v. 露营。作动词时 camp—camped—camped。
collocations: a summer camp; go camping; camp in the mountains
commonMistake: 表示“去露营”常用 go camping；camp 的现在分词双写 p：camping。

example.english: Our class will camp by the lake this weekend.
example.chinese: 我们班这周末要在湖边露营。

application.prompt: They put up a tent and spent the night outdoors. They went ___. A. shopping B. camping
application.solution: B。解析：搭帐篷在户外过夜是 go camping（去露营）。

grammar: n. 风景；景色；（自然）地貌。可数名词，复数 landscapes。
collocations: a beautiful landscape; mountain landscapes; landscape painting
commonMistake: landscape 可指一片景色或地貌；scenery 通常作不可数名词表示风景。

example.english: The green landscape looked beautiful after the rain.
example.chinese: 雨后的绿色景色很美。

application.prompt: The photo shows fields, hills, and a river. It shows a lovely ___. A. landscape B. suitcase
application.solution: A。解析：田野、山丘和河流构成一幅 landscape（景色）。

grammar: adj. 奇怪的；陌生的。be strange to sb 表示“对某人来说陌生”。
collocations: a strange sound; feel strange; be strange to me
commonMistake: strange 可表示“奇怪”或“陌生”；表示“对某人陌生”常用 be strange to sb。

example.english: I heard a strange noise outside the window.
example.chinese: 我听到窗外有一个奇怪的声音。

application.prompt: I have never been to this city, so everything is ___ to me. A. ready B. strange
application.solution: B。解析：句意为“我从没来过这座城市，所以一切对我都很陌生”。

grammar: n. 假期；度假。可数，常用 on vacation；美式英语常用 vacation，英式英语常用 holiday。
collocations: during the vacation; go on vacation; a summer vacation
commonMistake: 表示“在度假”用 on vacation；说去某地度假可用 go on vacation to...。

example.english: My family is on vacation in the countryside.
example.chinese: 我家人在乡村度假。

application.prompt: The children have no school this week. Their family is ___ in Sanya. A. on vacation B. at work
application.solution: A。解析：放假去三亚度假可说 be on vacation。

grammar: adj. 极好的；吸引人的；极大的。可作定语或表语；副词 fantastically。
collocations: a fantastic view; sound fantastic; a fantastic idea
commonMistake: fantastic 是形容词，作表语时与 be、sound、look 等连用。

example.english: We had a fantastic time at the science museum.
example.chinese: 我们在科学博物馆度过了非常愉快的时光。

application.prompt: The trip was wonderful. We had a ___ time. A. terrible B. fantastic
application.solution: B。解析：fantastic 表示“极好的”，与 wonderful 意思相近。

grammar: n. 镇；城镇；（城镇的）商业区。可数，复数 towns；in town 常指在镇上。
collocations: a small town; the town centre; go into town
commonMistake: town 指城镇或镇中心区域；搭配 in town 通常不加冠词。

example.english: There is a quiet park near the town centre.
example.chinese: 镇中心附近有一个安静的公园。

application.prompt: She grew up in a small ___ near the sea. A. town B. cloud
application.solution: A。解析：海边可以有一个 small town（小镇）。

grammar: n. 呼吸；一口气。可数；动词为 breathe，意为“呼吸”。
collocations: take a deep breath; hold one's breath; out of breath
commonMistake: breath 是名词，breathe 是动词；注意 breathe 末尾有不发音的 e。

example.english: She stopped for a moment to catch her breath.
example.chinese: 她停下来歇了一会儿，好喘口气。

application.prompt: After running up the stairs, Ben was out of ___. A. breathe B. breath
application.solution: B。解析：out of breath 是固定搭配，意为“上气不接下气”。

grammar: phr. 使某人惊叹；令某人屏息。sb 所指的人用所有格形式；主语通常是景色、表演等。
collocations: the view takes my breath away; take your breath away; breathtaking scenery
commonMistake: 短语中用 one's breath；主语是第三人称单数时 take 要加 -s。

example.english: The view from the mountain took our breath away.
example.chinese: 山上的景色令我们惊叹不已。

application.prompt: The sunset was so beautiful that it ___ away. A. took my breath B. took my ticket
application.solution: A。解析：take one's breath away 表示“令某人惊叹”。

grammar: adv. 尤其；特别。用于强调某人或某事；形容词是 especial，但常见对应形容词为 special。
collocations: especially important; especially for children; like ... especially
commonMistake: especially 用来突出强调，不能与 specially（专门地）在所有语境中互换。

example.english: I enjoy outdoor activities, especially hiking.
example.chinese: 我喜欢户外活动，尤其是徒步。

application.prompt: All the students enjoyed the trip, ___ the younger ones. A. slowly B. especially
application.solution: B。解析：此处强调“尤其是年纪较小的学生”，用 especially。

grammar: n. 汽锅鸡（汤）。steamed 为过去分词作定语，说明食物的制作方式；chicken soup 为中心名词。
collocations: a bowl of chicken soup; steamed chicken; serve chicken soup
commonMistake: steamed 修饰后面的食物名称；表达一碗汤用 a bowl of，不用 a soup。

example.english: We tried steamed chicken soup at a local restaurant.
example.chinese: 我们在当地餐馆尝了汽锅鸡。

application.prompt: The menu says the chicken is cooked by steaming. Which dish is it? A. steamed chicken soup B. fried rice
application.solution: A。解析：steamed chicken soup 指汽锅鸡；fried rice 是炒饭。

grammar: adv./pron. 在任何地方；随便哪个地方。常用于疑问句、否定句；肯定句常用 somewhere。
collocations: go anywhere; not find it anywhere; anywhere else
commonMistake: 肯定陈述中表示“某个地方”通常用 somewhere；否定句中常用 anywhere。

example.english: We couldn't find a quiet place anywhere in the busy town.
example.chinese: 在这个繁忙的小镇上，我们哪儿也找不到安静的地方。

application.prompt: Did you go ___ interesting during the holiday? A. nowhere B. anywhere
application.solution: B。解析：一般疑问句中表示“任何地方”通常用 anywhere。

grammar: pron. 没有事；没有任何东西。作主语时谓语用单数；nothing but 表示“只有”。
collocations: nothing to eat; say nothing; nothing happened
commonMistake: nothing 本身含否定意义，通常不再与 not 连用；作主语时用单数谓语。

example.english: Nothing was left in the picnic basket.
example.chinese: 野餐篮里什么也没剩下。

application.prompt: There ___ in the box except an old photo. A. is nothing B. are nothing
application.solution: A。解析：nothing 作主语，谓语用单数 is。

grammar: n. 导游；指南、手册；v. 给某人领路；指导。guide—guided—guided。
collocations: a tour guide; a travel guide; guide sb around a place
commonMistake: guide 可作人（导游）或资料（指南）；guide sb to/around... 表示带领某人。

example.english: Our guide showed us around the old palace.
example.chinese: 导游带我们参观了古老的宫殿。

application.prompt: A person who shows visitors around a city is a ___. A. scarf B. guide
application.solution: B。解析：带游客参观的人是 guide（导游）。

grammar: n. 风景；景色，通常不可数。常用 beautiful scenery；指具体的一片景观可说 a scene。
collocations: beautiful scenery; mountain scenery; enjoy the scenery
commonMistake: scenery 通常不可数，不说 a scenery 或 sceneries；不要与 scene（场景）混淆。

example.english: We stopped to enjoy the scenery along the river.
example.chinese: 我们停下来欣赏河边的风景。

application.prompt: The mountains and lake make the area famous for its ___. A. scenery B. scissors
application.solution: A。解析：scenery 表示自然风景，通常作不可数名词。

grammar: n. 丝绸；蚕丝，通常不可数。作定语修饰名词时常用 silk，如 a silk scarf。
collocations: silk clothes; a silk scarf; a piece of silk
commonMistake: 表示材质时 silk 通常不可数；表达“一条丝巾”说 a silk scarf，而不是 a silk。

example.english: She bought a light silk scarf at the market.
example.chinese: 她在市场买了一条轻薄的丝绸围巾。

application.prompt: This soft scarf is made of ___. A. silks B. silk
application.solution: B。解析：silk 表示丝绸材料时通常不可数。

grammar: n. 围巾；披巾。可数，复数常写 scarves，也可写 scarfs。
collocations: wear a scarf; a wool scarf; tie a scarf around your neck
commonMistake: scarf 的复数常用 scarves，注意 f 变 v 后加 -es；也可见 scarfs。

example.english: He wrapped a warm scarf around his neck.
example.chinese: 他把一条暖和的围巾围在脖子上。

application.prompt: There are two ___ on the shelf. A. scarves B. scarfses
application.solution: A。解析：scarf 的常见复数形式是 scarves。

grammar: adj. 准备好的；现成的；已做完的。教材词表还列 adv. 义“已做完；已完成”。常用 be ready for sth；be ready to do sth。
collocations: get ready; be ready for the trip; be ready to leave
commonMistake: be ready for 后接名词；be ready to 后接动词原形。

example.english: We are ready to leave for the station.
example.chinese: 我们准备好动身去车站了。

application.prompt: The bags are packed. We are ready ___ leave. A. for B. to
application.solution: B。解析：ready to do sth 后接动词原形，故用 to leave。

grammar: phr. 准备好做某事；愿意做某事。结构为 be ready to + 动词原形。
collocations: be ready to go; be ready to help; get ready to start
commonMistake: to 是不定式符号，后接动词原形；不要说 be ready doing。

example.english: The volunteers are ready to help the visitors.
example.chinese: 志愿者准备好帮助游客了。

application.prompt: Mia finished packing and is ready ___ the trip. A. to start B. starting
application.solution: A。解析：be ready to do sth 后接动词原形。

grammar: adv./pron. 在某处；到某处。常用于肯定句；疑问和否定语境常用 anywhere。
collocations: go somewhere quiet; live somewhere; somewhere else
commonMistake: somewhere 修饰形容词时形容词放后面：somewhere quiet；不说 somewhere quietly。

example.english: Let's find somewhere quiet to have lunch.
example.chinese: 我们找个安静的地方吃午饭吧。

application.prompt: We need ___ warm to wait for the bus. A. anywhere B. somewhere
application.solution: B。解析：肯定句提出建议时表示“某个地方”，用 somewhere。

grammar: pron. 我自己。可作宾语或同位语；固定表达 by myself 表示独自或亲自。
collocations: by myself; enjoy myself; teach myself
commonMistake: 反身代词需与主语一致：I 对应 myself；独自做某事可说 by myself。

example.english: I planned the whole trip by myself.
example.chinese: 这次旅行是我自己计划的。

application.prompt: I made this postcard ___ for my friend. A. myself B. yourself
application.solution: A。解析：主语是 I，对应的反身代词是 myself。

grammar: phr. 只有；只是。but 在此相当于 except，后接名词、代词或动词原形。
collocations: nothing but water; do nothing but wait; nothing but a mistake
commonMistake: nothing but 表示“只有”；do nothing but 后常接动词原形。

example.english: There was nothing but sand around the small house.
example.chinese: 小屋周围只有沙子。

application.prompt: He did ___ sit and wait for the bus. A. instead of B. nothing but
application.solution: B。解析：do nothing but do 表示“只做……”。

grammar: n. 旅馆；酒店。可数，复数 hotels；常用 stay at/in a hotel。
collocations: book a hotel; stay at a hotel; a hotel room
commonMistake: 表示住在旅馆可说 stay at a hotel；hotel 前有形容词时注意冠词，如 a comfortable hotel。

example.english: We stayed at a small hotel near the station.
example.chinese: 我们住在车站附近的一家小旅馆。

application.prompt: We booked a room and will stay ___ a hotel tonight. A. at B. on
application.solution: A。解析：stay at a hotel 是“住在旅馆”的常用搭配。

grammar: adj. 使人舒服的；舒适的。comfortably 是副词；名词 comfort。
collocations: a comfortable bed; feel comfortable; comfortable clothes
commonMistake: comfortable 描述令人舒服的事物或感受；修饰动词要用 comfortably。

example.english: These comfortable shoes are good for walking.
example.chinese: 这双舒适的鞋适合步行。

application.prompt: The sofa is soft, so we can sit ___. A. comfortable B. comfortably
application.solution: B。解析：修饰动词 sit 用副词 comfortably。

grammar: adj. 感到厌倦的；烦闷的。常用 be bored with/by；boring 表示“令人厌倦的”。
collocations: feel bored; be bored with sth; get bored
commonMistake: 人感到厌倦用 bored；使人厌倦的事物用 boring。

example.english: We were bored with waiting in the long line.
example.chinese: 排了很长的队，我们等得很烦。

application.prompt: The film lasted three hours and made us feel ___. A. bored B. boring
application.solution: A。解析：描述人的感受用 bored；令人厌倦的电影才是 boring。

grammar: n. 天；天空。通常说 the sky；可数时指某种天空或一片天空，复数 skies。
collocations: in the sky; a clear sky; look up at the sky
commonMistake: 通常说 the sky；描述天空颜色可说 the sky is blue。

example.english: Dark clouds covered the sky before the storm.
example.chinese: 暴风雨来临前，乌云遮住了天空。

application.prompt: The birds are flying high ___ the sky. A. at B. in
application.solution: B。解析：表示在天空中飞用 in the sky。

grammar: prep. 朝；向；接近。英式拼写 towards；美式英语也常见 toward。
collocations: walk towards the door; move towards the light; towards the end
commonMistake: towards 后接名词或代词；towards 与 toward 意思相同，拼写有地区差异。

example.english: The children ran towards their teacher.
example.chinese: 孩子们朝老师跑去。

application.prompt: The bus is moving ___ the city centre. A. towards B. during
application.solution: A。解析：表示朝某方向移动用 towards。

grammar: n. 虹；彩虹。可数，复数 rainbows；常用 a rainbow。
collocations: a bright rainbow; see a rainbow; a rainbow in the sky
commonMistake: rainbow 是可数名词，单数前通常加 a；复数直接加 -s。

example.english: A rainbow appeared after the rain.
example.chinese: 雨后出现了一道彩虹。

application.prompt: After the shower, we saw ___ over the hills. A. a thunder B. a rainbow
application.solution: B。解析：雨后天空中可见彩虹，rainbow 是可数名词。

examTags: 熟词多义·广场与正方形
grammar: n. 广场；正方形；adj. 正方形的；平方的。平方单位常用 square metres。
collocations: a town square; a square table; square kilometres
commonMistake: square 可作名词或形容词；表示面积单位时 square 放在单位前，如 square metres。

example.english: People were listening to music in the town square.
example.chinese: 人们在城镇广场上听音乐。

application.prompt: This shape has four equal sides and four right angles. It is a ___. A. square B. circle
application.solution: A。解析：四条边相等且四个角都是直角，才是 square（正方形）。

grammar: prep. 在……期间。后接名词或名词短语；表示持续时长用 for + 一段时间。
collocations: during the holiday; during the meeting; during the summer
commonMistake: during 后接某个时期或事件；for 后接持续时长，如 for two hours。

example.english: We took many photos during the trip.
example.chinese: 旅行期间我们拍了很多照片。

application.prompt: The museum is free ___ the school holiday. A. for B. during
application.solution: B。解析：school holiday 是一段时期，前用 during；for 后通常接时长。

grammar: n. 胜利；成功。可数，复数 victories；常用 a victory over sb/sth。
collocations: win a victory; a victory over the team; celebrate victory
commonMistake: victory 的复数为 victories，变 y 为 i 再加 -es；常说 win a victory。

example.english: The team celebrated its victory after the final game.
example.chinese: 决赛后，球队庆祝了胜利。

application.prompt: Our school team won ___ over the visitors. A. a victory B. a vacation
application.solution: A。解析：win a victory 表示“取得胜利”。

grammar: adj./n. 俄罗斯的；俄罗斯人；俄语。表示语言或国籍的人时首字母大写；可数名词复数 Russians。
collocations: Russian culture; speak Russian; a Russian artist
commonMistake: Russian 首字母要大写；the Russian language 可说俄语，Russia 才是国家名。

example.english: Our guide spoke Russian with the visitors.
example.chinese: 我们的导游用俄语和游客交谈。

application.prompt: The language is ___, and the country is Russia. A. Russia B. Russian
application.solution: B。解析：Russian 可表示俄语；Russia 是国家名。

grammar: n. 战斗；争斗；v. 打仗；打架；努力争取。过去式和过去分词 fought。
collocations: fight for peace; fight against a disease; have a fight
commonMistake: fight 的过去式是 fought，不是 fighted；表示与困难斗争可用 fight against。

example.english: They fought for peace during the war.
example.chinese: 战争期间，他们为和平而战。

application.prompt: Last night, the two teams ___ hard for the prize. A. fought B. fighted
application.solution: A。解析：fight 的过去式是不规则形式 fought。

grammar: prep. 反对；与……相反；紧靠。后接名词、代词或动名词；against the wall 表示靠着墙。
collocations: against the rules; lean against the wall; vote against the plan
commonMistake: against 是介词，后接名词或动名词，不直接接动词原形。

example.english: The bicycle was leaning against the wall.
example.chinese: 自行车靠在墙边。

application.prompt: It is ___ the rules to take photos here. A. during B. against
application.solution: B。解析：against the rules 表示“违反规定”。

grammar: phr. 与某人/某事物作战；与……作斗争。against 为介词，后接名词、代词或动名词。
collocations: fight against an enemy; fight against disease; fight against pollution
commonMistake: against 后接名词或代词；主语是单数第三人称时 fight 加 -s。

example.english: People are working together to fight against pollution.
example.chinese: 人们正共同努力对抗污染。

application.prompt: The villagers joined together to ___ the forest fire. A. fight against B. look for
application.solution: A。解析：与火灾作斗争可说 fight against the fire。

grammar: n. 艺术作品；插图。表示一件具体作品时可数，复数 artworks；也可作集合性用法。
collocations: a piece of artwork; original artwork; artwork for a book
commonMistake: 表示“一件艺术作品”可说 a piece of artwork；不要把 artwork 与 artist（艺术家）混淆。

example.english: The children displayed their artwork in the school hall.
example.chinese: 孩子们在学校礼堂展示了他们的艺术作品。

application.prompt: The students put their paintings on the wall as ___. A. luggage B. artwork
application.solution: B。解析：绘画作品可统称为 artwork。

grammar: phr. 数以千计的；成千上万的。后接可数名词复数，谓语通常用复数。
collocations: thousands of people; thousands of years; thousands of stars
commonMistake: thousands of 后接名词复数；具体数字前不加 -s 和 of，如 two thousand people。

example.english: Thousands of visitors come to the old town each year.
example.chinese: 每年有成千上万名游客来到这座古镇。

application.prompt: ___ people visit the museum every month. A. Thousands of B. Thousand of
application.solution: A。解析：泛指成千上万时用 thousands of。

grammar: n. 眼泪；泪水。可数，常用 a tear；tear 作“撕裂”时也可作动词，但读音不同。
collocations: tears of joy; burst into tears; wipe away a tear
commonMistake: 本课 tear 指“眼泪”；同形动词 tear（撕）读音不同，注意依语境辨义。

example.english: A tear rolled down her cheek when she said goodbye.
example.chinese: 她道别时，一滴眼泪顺着脸颊滑落。

application.prompt: The sad film brought ___ to the boy's eyes. A. tickets B. tears
application.solution: B。解析：bring tears to one's eyes 表示“使某人流泪”。

grammar: v. 提醒；使想起。常用 remind sb to do sth、remind sb of sth、remind sb that...。
collocations: remind me to call; remind sb of a place; remind us that...
commonMistake: “提醒某人做某事”用 remind sb to do，不说 remind sb do；of 后接名词或代词。

example.english: Please remind me to bring my passport tomorrow.
example.chinese: 请提醒我明天带护照。

application.prompt: The guide reminded us ___ quiet in the museum. A. to be B. being
application.solution: A。解析：remind sb to do sth 后接不定式。

grammar: n. 和平；太平，通常不可数。peaceful 为形容词；常说 make/keep peace。
collocations: world peace; live in peace; peace and quiet
commonMistake: peace 表示抽象的“和平”时通常不可数；“和平的”用 peaceful。

example.english: The visitors learned about the country's history and its hopes for peace.
example.chinese: 游客了解了这个国家的历史以及人们对和平的希望。

application.prompt: People around the world hope to live in ___. A. peaceful B. peace
application.solution: B。解析：介词 in 后用名词 peace；peaceful 是形容词。

grammar: adv. 容易地；轻易地。形容词 easy 的副词形式，y 变 i 再加 -ly。
collocations: easily understand; move easily; be easily found
commonMistake: easy 的副词是 easily；修饰动词用副词，不用形容词 easy。

example.english: You can easily reach the station by metro.
example.chinese: 你可以很容易地乘地铁到达车站。

application.prompt: The map is clear, so visitors can find the palace ___. A. easily B. easy
application.solution: A。解析：修饰动词 find 用副词 easily。

grammar: v. 忘记；遗忘。forget—forgot—forgotten；forget to do 表示忘记去做，forget doing 表示忘记做过。
collocations: forget a name; forget to bring sth; forget doing sth
commonMistake: forget to do 指事情还没做而忘了；forget doing 指忘了做过某事。

example.english: I forgot to pack my camera, so I couldn't take photos.
example.chinese: 我忘了带相机，所以没能拍照。

application.prompt: Please don't ___ to lock the door before you leave. A. remember B. forget
application.solution: B。解析：提醒对方不要忘记去锁门，用 forget to do。

grammar: n. 正午；中午。通常不可数；at noon 表示“在中午”。
collocations: at noon; around noon; by noon
commonMistake: 表示“在正午”用 at noon，通常不加 the。

example.english: The museum closes for lunch at noon.
example.chinese: 博物馆中午闭馆用午餐。

application.prompt: The train leaves at ___. A. noon B. midnight
application.solution: A。解析：noon 是中午，midnight 是午夜。

grammar: adj. 生病的；恶心的。be sick 常指生病；feel sick 常指感到恶心，也可指不适。
collocations: a sick child; feel sick; be sick in bed
commonMistake: sick 可表示“生病”或“恶心”；描述病人可说 a sick person，描述感受用 feel sick。

example.english: The long bus ride made me feel sick.
example.chinese: 长时间坐公交让我觉得恶心。

application.prompt: After the rough boat ride, Ella began to feel ___. A. safe B. sick
application.solution: B。解析：乘船颠簸后感到恶心用 feel sick。

grammar: n. 地铁系统；地下铁道。可数；英式英语常说 underground/tube，美式英语常说 subway。
collocations: take the metro; a metro station; travel by metro
commonMistake: 表示乘地铁可说 take the metro 或 travel by metro；by 后不加 the。

example.english: We took the metro to the city centre.
example.chinese: 我们乘地铁去了市中心。

application.prompt: The roads were busy, so we went downtown by ___. A. metro B. passport
application.solution: A。解析：metro 是地铁，适合在城市中出行。

grammar: n. 车站；站；局。可数，复数 stations；可指火车站、地铁站、电视台等。
collocations: a train station; a metro station; at the station
commonMistake: station 的具体意思由语境决定；表示在车站常用 at the station。

example.english: Let's meet at the metro station at six.
example.chinese: 我们六点在地铁站见面吧。

application.prompt: Passengers are waiting for the train at the ___. A. scarf B. station
application.solution: B。解析：乘客等火车的地方是 station（车站）。

grammar: n. 王宫；宫殿。可数，复数 palaces；具体宫殿名称中的 Palace 通常大写。
collocations: a royal palace; visit a palace; the palace gates
commonMistake: palace 是“宫殿”，不要与 place（地方）混淆拼写。

example.english: The old palace is open to visitors every day.
example.chinese: 这座古老的宫殿每天都对游客开放。

application.prompt: A king or queen may live in a ___. A. palace B. station
application.solution: A。解析：王室居住的宫殿是 palace。

grammar: n. 手风琴。可数，复数 accordions；乐器前通常用 play the。
collocations: play the accordion; an accordion player; accordion music
commonMistake: 表示演奏乐器通常用 play the accordion；不要漏掉定冠词 the。

example.english: My grandfather can play the accordion very well.
example.chinese: 我爷爷手风琴拉得很好。

application.prompt: Lily learned to play ___ accordion last year. A. a B. the
application.solution: B。解析：乐器名称前通常用定冠词 the。

grammar: phr. 聚会；相聚。可作不及物短语，后接 with sb 或 for an event 说明对象或目的。
collocations: get together with friends; get together for dinner; get together at weekends
commonMistake: 表示和某人相聚用 get together with sb；不要误写成 get together to sb。

example.english: Our family gets together every New Year.
example.chinese: 我们一家人每年新年都会团聚。

application.prompt: The classmates plan to ___ after the exams. A. get together B. turn around
application.solution: A。解析：考试后同学们计划聚会，用 get together。

grammar: phr. 在阳光下；在太阳照射下。sun 前通常用 the；注意与 under the sun（世上）区分语境。
collocations: sit in the sun; dry clothes in the sun; read in the sun
commonMistake: 固定说 in the sun；sun 前通常要加 the。

example.english: The children sat in the sun and ate their lunch.
example.chinese: 孩子们坐在阳光下吃午餐。

application.prompt: Don't leave the ice cream ___ too long; it will melt. A. at noon B. in the sun
application.solution: B。解析：在阳光下冰淇淋容易融化，应用 in the sun。

grammar: n. 塔；塔楼。可数，复数 towers；作动词可表示高耸，但本课常用名词义。
collocations: a tall tower; a clock tower; the top of the tower
commonMistake: tower 是可数名词；单数前通常需要冠词 a/the。

example.english: We could see the tower from the hotel window.
example.chinese: 从旅馆窗户能看到那座塔。

application.prompt: The old clock is at the top of the stone ___. A. tower B. valley
application.solution: A。解析：钟常安装在 clock tower（钟楼）上。

grammar: modal v. 可能；可以。might 后接动词原形，常表示较不确定的可能；无人称变化。
collocations: might be late; might rain; might help
commonMistake: might 后直接接动词原形，不加 to，也不随主语变化。

example.english: It might rain this afternoon, so take an umbrella.
example.chinese: 今天下午可能会下雨，所以带把伞。

application.prompt: We ___ visit the museum if we have enough time. A. might to B. might
application.solution: B。解析：情态动词 might 后接动词原形 visit。

grammar: n. 预算；v. 把……编入预算；精打细算。可数名词；动词过去式拼作 budgeted，不双写 t。
collocations: a limited budget; stay within budget; budget for a trip
commonMistake: budget 的过去式是 budgeted，只加 -ed，不双写 t；within budget 表示“控制在预算之内”。

example.english: We planned a two-day trip on a small budget.
example.chinese: 我们用有限的预算计划了一次两日游。

application.prompt: The family wants to spend less and stay ___ budget. A. within B. between
application.solution: A。解析：stay within budget 表示“控制在预算之内”。

grammar: n. 护照。可数，复数 passports；常用 passport number、show one's passport。
collocations: a valid passport; renew a passport; show your passport
commonMistake: passport 是可数名词；出境旅行时要注意其有效期，passport 前按语境用 a/the。

example.english: Please keep your passport in a safe place.
example.chinese: 请把护照放在安全的地方。

application.prompt: You need this official document to travel to another country. It is a ___. A. poster B. passport
application.solution: B。解析：出国旅行的证件是 passport（护照）。

grammar: adj. 健忘的；好忘事的。由 forget + -ful 构成；名词 forgetfulness。
collocations: a forgetful person; become forgetful; be forgetful about names
commonMistake: forgetful 描述“容易忘事的”；forgotten 是 forget 的过去分词，词性和用法不同。

example.english: My grandpa is a little forgetful about names.
example.chinese: 我爷爷有点容易忘记名字。

application.prompt: She often leaves her keys at home. She can be quite ___. A. forgetful B. careful
application.solution: A。解析：经常忘带钥匙说明她有些健忘，用 forgetful。

grammar: adj. 远方的；遥远的，通常作定语；far away 可作副词短语表示“在远处”。
collocations: a faraway place; a faraway land; seem far away
commonMistake: faraway 通常作形容词修饰名词；far away 常作表语或状语，注意分写。

example.english: She dreamed of visiting a faraway island.
example.chinese: 她梦想去一座遥远的岛屿。

application.prompt: The explorer wrote about a ___ country across the sea. A. nearby B. faraway
application.solution: B。解析：across the sea 表明这个国家很远，应用 faraway。

grammar: adj. 平常的；有规律的；定期的。副词 regularly；名词 regularity。
collocations: a regular bus service; regular exercise; a regular customer
commonMistake: regular 可指“定期的”或“普通的”；副词用 regularly，不是 regular。

example.english: Regular exercise can help you stay healthy.
example.chinese: 规律锻炼有助于保持健康。

application.prompt: The bus comes every 20 minutes on a ___ schedule. A. regular B. strange
application.solution: A。解析：按固定时间运行的班次是 regular（有规律的）。

grammar: n. 乡村；农村，通常作单数集合概念。常用 in the countryside。
collocations: live in the countryside; the quiet countryside; countryside roads
commonMistake: 表示“在乡村”常用 in the countryside；不要漏掉定冠词 the。

example.english: My aunt lives in the countryside, far from the city.
example.chinese: 我姑姑住在乡村，离城市很远。

application.prompt: They moved from the city to live ___ the countryside. A. on B. in
application.solution: B。解析：固定表达为 in the countryside。

examTags: 熟词多义·转身与改变方向
grammar: phr. 转身；转向；翻转。作不及物短语时无需宾语；宾语代词置于 turn 和 around 之间时多指“把……转过来”。
collocations: turn around quickly; turn the car around; turn around and look
commonMistake: turn around 可表示自己转身；若宾语是代词，放在中间：turn it around。

example.english: I heard my name and turned around.
example.chinese: 我听到有人叫我的名字，便转过身来。

application.prompt: When the guide called him, Ben ___ to see who it was. A. turned around B. looked for
application.solution: A。解析：听见有人叫时转身看，用 turn around。

grammar: adj. 感到惊奇的；惊讶的。常用 be surprised at/by sth、be surprised to do、be surprised that...。
collocations: feel surprised; be surprised at the news; be surprised to see sb
commonMistake: 人感到惊讶用 surprised；令人惊讶的事物用 surprising。

example.english: We were surprised to see snow in April.
example.chinese: 四月见到雪，我们感到很惊讶。

application.prompt: The visitors were ___ by the sudden change in weather. A. surprising B. surprised
application.solution: B。解析：visitors 是感到惊讶的人，用 surprised。

grammar: n. 鹿。单复数同形，one deer / several deer；动词随数量变化。
collocations: a deer in the forest; a herd of deer; wild deer
commonMistake: deer 的复数仍为 deer，不加 -s；根据数量判断谓语单复数。

example.english: We saw three deer near the trees.
example.chinese: 我们在树附近看到了三只鹿。

application.prompt: There ___ two deer in the field. A. are B. is
application.solution: A。解析：two deer 表示复数，be 动词用 are。

grammar: adv. 很可能；大概。常放在实义动词前、be 动词后或情态动词后。
collocations: probably be late; will probably rain; most probably
commonMistake: probably 修饰整句或动词，位置通常在 will 等情态动词之后、实义动词之前。

example.english: The metro will probably be faster than the bus today.
example.chinese: 今天地铁很可能比公交快。

application.prompt: It ___ take about an hour to reach the countryside. A. probably will to B. will probably
application.solution: B。解析：probably 可放在情态动词 will 后，实义动词原形前。

grammar: phr. 寻找，强调寻找的过程。look for 的结果不一定是找到；find 表示找到的结果。
collocations: look for a hotel; look for your passport; look for information
commonMistake: look for 表示“寻找”，find 表示“找到”；不要把两者混为一谈。

example.english: We looked for the metro entrance but couldn't find it.
example.chinese: 我们寻找地铁入口，但没有找到。

application.prompt: I can't see my key. I need to ___ it before we leave. A. look for B. look after
application.solution: A。解析：还在寻找钥匙，用 look for；look after 是照顾。

grammar: n. 纳粹党人；纳粹分子。复数 Nazis；作为历史专名及其派生形容词时首字母大写。
collocations: Nazi Germany; Nazi leaders; the Nazi Party
commonMistake: Nazi 首字母大写，复数为 Nazis；历史语境中注意其特定含义。

example.english: The museum has a section about Nazi Germany and World War II.
example.chinese: 博物馆设有关于纳粹德国和第二次世界大战的展区。

application.prompt: A person who belonged to the Nazi Party during World War II was a ___. A. tourist B. Nazi
application.solution: B。解析：Nazi 可指纳粹党人或纳粹分子。
